Container.Name: net2net-unifi-radius
Container.Overview: Net2Net UniFi RADIUS. Local users, VLAN profiles, PEAP/MSCHAPv2 and accounting. Set a unique administrator password of at least 12 characters before first start. For a dedicated LAN IP, select your custom br0 network and assign an unused address.

Config.Name: Initial administrator password
Config.Description: Required on first start. Choose a unique password with at least 12 characters. Initializes an empty database only.

Config.Name: RADIUS certificate DNS name
Config.Description: Set before first start. Clients validate this name against the generated server certificate.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, encryption key, certificates and accounting logs

Config.Name: Web portal
Config.Description: Portal host port when using bridge networking; dedicated br0 uses port 8080 directly
